content.user_title: Organize SoftSync Groups, Views, and Dashboards
content.value_statement: Teams need consistent ways to organize records, control access, and review shared reports. This skill guides SoftSync group management, saved views, member roles, and dashboard updates.
actual_capabilities: Discover workspace groups and retrieve a group with its views.
Create, rename, describe, duplicate, delete, and change sharing for groups.
List group members and add, remove, or change their roles after confirming access details.
Create, update, and delete table, kanban, calendar, and timeline views using workspace field identifiers.
List dashboards and manage dashboards or charts according to group permissions.
Test chart definitions through generate_analytics, including forecasts and past snapshots, before saving them.
limitations: Requires access to the referenced SoftSync tools and a workspace; the skill does not include a standalone integration.
Views display group records but do not store records themselves.
Boards require a choice field; calendars require a date field; timelines require a start date.
Adding a member exposes every record in the group; dashboard renaming and deletion require an owner or admin.

use_cases.title: Organize project work
use_cases.description: Find an existing project group and configure a kanban board using its status choice field.

use_cases.title: Review team access
use_cases.description: List group members, review their roles, and confirm intended access before changing membership.

use_cases.title: Maintain shared reporting
use_cases.description: Inspect dashboard charts, test a revised analytics definition, and update the intended chart by position.

prompt_templates.title: Find a group
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the existing group named [group name] and list its saved views. Do not create or modify anything.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a board
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [group name] and its field identifiers. Create a kanban view named [view name] using [choice field], after checking existing views.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a membership change
prompt_templates.prompt: List members of [group name]. Prepare to add [email] as Viewer, but confirm the person and role with me before granting access.

prompt_templates.title: Revise a shared chart
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect dashboards in [group name]. Test [chart definition] with generate_analytics, then update chart position [position] in [dashboard] only after successful validation.

output_examples.input: What would you check before creating a project kanban view?
output: Find the existing project group and inspect its saved views.
Identify the status choice field and obtain its field identifier from the workspace schema.
Use that field for board columns; a view displays existing group records without storing separate records.

output_examples.input: What access would an external reviewer receive if added as Viewer?
output: Viewer access is read only and applies to everything in the group.
A person outside the workspace joins as a guest when added by email.
Confirm the reviewer email and Viewer role before adding the member.

output_examples.input: How should I prepare a replacement dashboard chart?
output: List dashboards and identify the target chart by its position.
Test the proposed definition with generate_analytics before saving it.
Group editors may change charts; renaming or deleting the dashboard requires an owner or admin.

best_practices: Check existing groups before creating another group, and use workspace schema identifiers for view fields.
Confirm each person and role before adding members because access covers the entire group.
Test chart definitions with generate_analytics before saving, and verify the dashboard and chart position before updating.
anti_patterns: Creating a new group without checking whether the intended group already exists.
Adding someone without confirming their identity, role, and access to every record in the group.
Creating boards or calendars with unsupported field types or guessed field identifiers.

faq.question: Which saved view types are supported?
faq.answer: The skill documents table, kanban board, calendar, and timeline views. Timeline views are Gantt charts.

faq.question: Does a view hold its own records?
faq.answer: No. A view is a saved way to display records held in its group.

faq.question: What fields do boards and calendars need?
faq.answer: Boards need a choice field for columns. Calendars need a date field. Use field identifiers from the workspace schema.

faq.question: Can I invite someone outside the workspace?
faq.answer: Yes. Someone added by email joins as a guest if not already in the workspace. Confirm the person and role first.

faq.question: Who can change shared dashboards?
faq.answer: Group editors may change charts. Renaming or deleting a dashboard requires a group owner or admin.

faq.question: Does the skill work without SoftSync tools?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions for SoftSync workspace tools and requires those tools to inspect or change groups, views, and dashboards.
